title: The contractible scalar realization adjunction
statement: Let J be an essentially small site with C in Type(u+1), Hom in Type u, and let O be a commutative abelian-sheaf ring object. Let U be terminal. Use the actual functors F and G of [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model] and assume the small sectionwise derived category exists. If terminal evaluation has the exact cocontinuous, representative-normalized derived tensor data [lem-zl-contractible-derived-sections-tensor], then there is an adjunction F left adjoint to G with invertible unit; F is strong symmetric monoidal for the ordinary Koszul braidings and G is strong monoidal.

proof.text: Transport exact cocontinuous sections through the section-module equivalence. The constant-section counit defines the ringed-topos realization/sections adjunction.
The unit is identity on a rank-one free module. Coproduct preservation extends this to all free modules; a free presentation and exact sections prove it for every module.
Derive using flat-term K-flat resolutions. Uniqueness of universal derived pairs identifies the chosen F and G and the derived unit with the degreewise ordinary unit.
Canonical derived tensor pullback gives the strong symmetric structure on F. Transport the normalized monoidal evaluation data to G, using localization uniqueness also across localization universes.
